entries.title: EUR/USD clings to gains as Trump strikes Fed’s independence
entries.description: EUR/USD ticks lower but trades firmly around 1.1500 during European trading hours on Tuesday. The major currency pair is taking a sigh of relief after a strong rally in the last few weeks.
entries.author: FXStreet

entries.title: EUR/USD breaks 1.15 on 'Sell America' momentum – Danske Bank
entries.description: The US Dollar (USD) extended its decline as markets reacted to Trump's threats against Fed Chair Powell, worsening US asset market dynamics, and thin holiday liquidity. EUR/USD surged past 1.15, driven by ongoing risk aversion and safe-haven rotation away from the greenback.
entries.author: FXStreet

entries.title: EUR/USD Forecast: Euro corrective losses to remain limited in near term
entries.description: EUR/USD seems to have entered a consolidation phase near 1.1500 after gaining more than 1% and touching its highest level since 2021 above 1.1570. The pair's technical outlook suggests that the bullish bias remains intact in the near term, while signalling a loss of momentum.
entries.author: FXStreet

entries.title: EUR: 1.20 discussion now open – ING
entries.description: The latest round of dollar depreciation has sent EUR/USD through the 1.150 level. Now, there isn’t any other key resistance until 1.20. Picking a top in the pair has proven a frustrating exercise, and Trump’s attack on the Fed is likely extending the confidence crisis on the dollar.
entries.author: FXStreet

entries.title: EUR/USD Price Forecast: Bulls pause but retain control
entries.description: The EUR/USD pair surged past the 1.1500 mark on Monday, reaching levels that were last seen in November 2021 amid a continued US Dollar (USD) sell-off. The Greenback plummeted following an extended weekend, with thinned market conditions exacerbating the slide.
entries.author: FXStreet

entries.title: EUR/USD Forecast: Euro looks to extend rally after setting new multi-year high
entries.description: EUR/USD gathers bullish momentum on Monday and trades at its highest level since November 2021 above 1.1500, gaining over 1% on a daily basis.
entries.author: FXStreet

entries.title: EUR/USD Weekly Forecast: From rally to reality, Euro loses grip above 1.1400
entries.description: EUR/USD maintained its positive footing this week, extending its four‑week bullish run.
entries.author: FXStreet

entries.title: EUR/USD Forecast: Euro struggles to stretch higher after ECB
entries.description: EUR/USD trades in a narrow channel at around 1.1370 after closing in negative territory on Thursday. With major financial markets remaining closed in observance of the Easter Holiday on Friday, the pair is likely to extend its sideways grind heading into the weekend.
entries.author: FXStreet

entries.title: EUR/USD Price Forecast: Upside remains capped by 1.1400 and above
entries.description: The Euro (EUR) lost momentum on Thursday, encouraging sellers to return to the market and drive EUR/USD lower following a failed attempt to reclaim the area beyond 1.1400 the figure during early trade.
entries.author: FXStreet

entries.title: EUR/USD Price Forecast: Bulls retain control amid ECB announcement
entries.description: The FX board entered holiday mood on Thursday, with most major pairs confined to tight intraday ranges throughout the first half of the day. The EUR/USD pair hovered a few pips below the 1.1400 mark after posting an intraday peak of 1.1409 early in the Asian session.
entries.author: FXStreet

entries.title: Live Coverage: Lagarde may show resilience in face of uncertainty, EUR/USD set to rock
entries.description: The ECB is set to cut rates again, but what will it do next? After surging, EUR/USD is waiting for the next piece of news.
entries.author: FXStreet

entries.title: EUR/USD Forecast: Euro could extend correction on a dovish ECB tone
entries.description: EUR/USD gained traction and registered its highest daily close since February 2022 at 1.1400 on Wednesday. The pair corrects lower toward 1.1350 early Thursday as investors await the European Central Bank's (ECB) monetary policy announcements.
entries.author: FXStreet

entries.title: EUR/USD Price Forecast: Door remains open to extra gains near term
entries.description: The Euro (EUR) managed to regain steam on Wednesday, revisiting the area of yearly peaks against the US Dollar (USD).
entries.author: FXStreet
